title: APB4 Slave Peripheral
constraints: Registers: `0x00` CTRL (RW), `0x04` DATA (RW), `0x08` ID (RO, reads `0xA9B00001`), `0x0C` WCOUNT (RO: number of successful writes, 32-bit wrapping).
A transfer completes in its access phase (`psel && penable`). `pready` is always 1 (no wait states). A write updates the register on that rising edge, byte-lane-wise according to `pstrb`.

`pslverr = 1` during an access phase that is an error: unaligned address (`paddr[1:0] != 0`), an address above `0x0C`, or a **write** to a read-only register. Errored writes have no effect and are not counted. `pslverr = 0` outside access phases.

`prdata` = the addressed register whenever `psel && !pwrite` (0 for unmapped or unaligned addresses), otherwise 0. Combinational. `presetn` is an active-low synchronous reset that clears CTRL, DATA and WCOUNT.
hints: Decode once: `wire access = psel & penable;` and a `valid_addr` / `ro_reg` decode on `paddr`.
Byte strobes: `for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (pstrb[i]) ctrl[8*i +: 8] <= pwdata[8*i +: 8];`
WCOUNT counts only successful writes. An errored write must leave every register unchanged.
